messages:
Harper: Quick brief  we need a compact creative pack for the July benchmarks push: 1 hero banner (static), 3 comparison tiles, a compact SDR routing infographic, and a webinar cover slide. Final assets by Friday COB.
Mira: Copy. Any specific visual treatment for the benchmark tiles?
Harper: Keep them modular: left icon, center sparkline for cost, right stacked bars for latency. Make room for a tiny "fallback" badge (model variant fallback) and a legal footnote.
Jon: Routing: score >= 60 -> SDR queue + slack alert (#sdr-alert); score < 60 -> nurture sequence (7 days). Here's the snippet we use for product docs if you want to mirror in the visual:
```
routes:
  - name: high_intent
    match: score >= 60
    action: assign_sdr + slack_alert(#sdr-alert)
  - name: nurture
    match: score < 60
    action: start_drip(days=7)
```
Priya: Brand constraints: new palette (deep-navy, coral, moss), Inter type family, H1 44 semibold. Icons: flat two-tone. Ensure AA contrast and include accessible alt-text placeholder in the Figma file.
Mira: Export sizes requested: PNG 1200x628 (social), PNG 640x360 (thumb), PNG 1920x1080 (webinar). Also need SVGs for icons and a PDF handoff for Growth. Include localizable text layers for en-US and en-GB.
Harper: Bench numbers for copy: Hosted p50=92ms cost=$0.0027; Dedicated p50=66ms cost=$0.00158; Private p50=73ms cost=$0.00205. Wording: avoid absolutes like "cheapest"  use "most cost-efficient at scale". Add footnote: "Based on internal Redwood performance tests, June 2025."
Priya: I'll prep legal-friendly footnote text and run brand sweep Thu evening. Also confirm trademark usages.
Mira: Any animation required?
Harper: Not for this pass. Static only. Growth may request a GIF later but separate ticket.
design-bot: Asset checklist generated: [Figma master file, PNG 1200x628, PNG 640x360, PNG 1920x1080, SVG icons, PDF handoff, localization-ready text layers, accessibility notes].
Mira: Timeline: I'll post first drafts Wed afternoon and a refined pass Thu morning. Please comment in Figma (link will be posted) rather than long replies here.
Jon: Adding note  ensure the routing diagram fits in an email-width stripe (600px) and scales to mobile.
Harper: Great. Once draft is up I'll do copy pass and Priya will sign off legal/brand. Thanks all :rocket:
